retrievalProfile.description: A centered circular medallion featuring airbrushed rainbow gradients and lightning-bolt typography, flanked by classical statues on ornate corbels against a marble background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a large central circular frame with a beveled metallic edge. Inside the circle is a sky-blue background with a multi-colored rainbow inner border. The typography is stacked and stylized with lightning bolt extensions. The entire scene is set against a distressed grey marble texture, with two classical, monochromatic figures (one angelic, one demonic) perched on ornate architectural corbels at the 10 o'clock and 4 o'clock positions.
coreVisualRelationships: Circular medallion centered within a square marble field
Classical figures balancing the composition diagonally
Vibrant rainbow gradients contrasting with monochromatic stone textures
Sharp, geometric typography integrated with fluid lightning motifs
coreInvariants: Circular frame with beveled metallic appearance

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central medallion occupying 70% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central circular frame and the bold, multi-colored typography within it.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular motion following the frame, punctuated by the diagonal placement of the two statues.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The marble texture provides a textured negative space that frames the central graphic.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Rainbow spectrum (red, orange, yellow, green, blue) within the medallion
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black and white for the classical figures and outer border
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central graphic against low-saturation, high-texture surroundings.
paletteRestrictions: Muted stone tones for the exterior
Full spectrum airbrushed gradients for the interior

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and sans-serif hybrids
letterConstructionRules: Horizontal bars extend into lightning bolt shapes
Heavy black outlines for legibility against gradients
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'T' and 'E' have elongated top bars that zig-zag like electricity
The 'B' and 'D' in the bottom row have tails that extend into lightning bolts
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, colorful illustrative type paired with subtle, engraved classical serifs.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy weight and decorative extensions of the main title.
Appropriate for the engraved subtitle text at the bottom.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image of a grey distressed marble slab. In the center, place a large beveled metallic circular frame. Inside the frame, add a light blue sky with a multi-colored rainbow ring border. Place two monochromatic classical statues on ornate stone corbels at the upper-left and lower-right edges of the circle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add stacked custom lettering in the center of the circle with rainbow airbrushed gradients and thick black outlines. Ensure the top and bottom lines have horizontal bars that extend into lightning bolt shapes. Engrave a light serif subtitle into the bottom curve of the metallic frame.

verificationChecks: Is the marble texture visible behind the medallion?
Do the lightning bolts extend horizontally from the letters?
Are the two statues placed diagonally opposite each other?
Is the rainbow gradient smooth and airbrushed in appearance?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the lightning bolt extensions
postGenerationChecks: Check that the lightning bolts don't obscure the letter legibility.
Verify the metallic bevel on the circular frame looks three-dimensional.
Ensure the statues look like stone carvings, not photographs.
Confirm the rainbow colors follow a logical spectrum order.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central circular medallion + marble background + classical architectural elements + airbrushed illustrative typography.
